title: AI in 60 Minutes: Free Starter Course
subtitle: Go from 'I've heard of ChatGPT' to using AI confidently for emails, summaries and planning in about an hour. Free.
description:
You have heard people talk about ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude, maybe even opened one once, but you are not sure what to type or whether you can trust the answers. This free course is built for exactly that moment. In about an hour you will set up a free AI assistant safely and use it for real tasks from your own life.

It is made for students, working professionals, homemakers and career returners, and small business owners across India. No technical background is needed. If you can send a WhatsApp message, you can do this course.

The course has six short lessons, each 8-12 minutes, with a small hands-on exercise in every one. You will write your first useful prompts, learn a simple four-part formula that makes answers far better, and understand what you should never paste into an AI tool.

You finish with a 7-day habit plan so AI becomes part of your routine, and a free certificate of completion once you mark every lesson complete.
audience: Students who want help with studying, notes and applications
Working professionals who want to save time on emails and documents
Homemakers and career returners building confidence with new tools
Small business owners who want quick help with messages and planning
Anyone who has heard of ChatGPT but barely uses it
outcomes: Explain in plain words what an AI chat assistant can and cannot do
Set up a free ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude account safely
Use AI to draft an email, summarise a long text and explain a tough topic
Write better prompts with the role, task, context, format formula
Spot hallucinations and fact-check AI answers before you rely on them
Know what personal and business information never to paste into AI
Follow a simple 7-day plan to make AI a daily habit
prerequisites: A smartphone or computer with internet access
An email address to sign up for a free AI account
No technical or coding knowledge needed
projects: Set up a free AI assistant account with safe privacy settings
Use five starter prompts on real tasks from your own week
Rewrite a weak prompt into a strong one using the four-part formula
Build your personal 7-day AI habit plan
